observations.title: Normal account switch isolation and final application capacity revalidation after AI draft
steps: A confirms normal logout. B normal OTP/profile has fresh AI conversation and blank application editor; no A draft or dialogue inherited.
With actual capacity1/2, B explicitly searches, selects real meal, generates application draft and explicitly transfers it; no submission yet.
In separate host browser H normally approves A, actual count becomes2/2.
B submits the already-open original draft editor once; UI reports This table is full and no longer taking requests; draft remains. No forced hidden action or updated business data used.
Read-only before/after applications, seat_events, meals and messages count plus sorted row hashes are identical. No new B application or seat.
Still partial005: exact deadline counterexample, cross-client reversal and same-database Admin requirements remain unpassed.
